articles.summary: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group announced the appointment of Christopher Peirce to its Board of Directors, effective Feb. 1, 2026. A seasoned financial and operational leader, Peirce brings 30 years of global property and casualty experience from Liberty Mutual Insurance, where he served as chief financial officer and president of Global Specialty and Commercial Markets. His appointment further strengthens Skyward Specialty’s board as the Company prepares for continued growth and strategic initiatives.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty Welcomes Christopher Peirce to Board of Directors - Skyward Specialty Insurance

articles.summary: Skyward Specialty Insurance Group announced the promotion of John Burkhart to President, U.S. Property & Casualty. In this expanded role, Burkhart will oversee the Company’s Captives & Specialty Programs divisions, in addition to his current leadership of Professional Lines, Industry Solutions, Surety, Accident & Health, and Transactional E&S. Claims, Technology Solution Services, and Pricing Actuarial will also report to him, further strengthening operational alignment to support Skyward Specialty’s continued growth and strategic execution.
articles.title: Skyward Specialty Promotes John Burkhart to President, U.S. Property & Casualty - Skyward Specialty Insurance
